condition.narrative: No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective date, or such later date as agreed by the Bank, the ORMVAT, the ORMVASM and theONCA, as per their Project Agreement, establish and thereafter maintain, throughout Project implementation, a Project managementunit staffed with adequate professional, fiduciary, administrative, technical, environmental and social personnel, withqualifications, experience and ToR acceptable to the Bank, all as described in the POM, responsible for the day-to-dayimplementation, M&E of its Respective Part of the Project.

Section I-A-1 (a) of Schedule 2. No later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, or such later date as agreed by the Bank,appoint and thereafter maintain, throughout Project implementation, a Central Project Management Unit (“CPMU”), within theMAPMDREF/DIAEA.

Section I-A-1 (b) of Schedule 2. No later than ninety (120) days after the Effective Date, or such other date as agreed by theBank, establish, and thereafter maintain, throughout Project implementation, a steering committee, chaired by the MAPMDREF andcomposed of representatives of the Borrower's ministries and institutions participating in the implementation, monitoring andevaluation of the Project, including relevant ORMVAs, ONCA and the relevant ABHs.

Section I-A-4 (a) of Schedule 2. No later than forty-five (45) days after the Effective Date, or any later date as agreed by theBank, prepare a manual acceptable to the Bank (POM), and immediately thereafter, ensure that the Project is implemented inaccordance with the POM.

comment.narrative:

title.narrative: Number of wells equipped with water meters in Chtouka area

comment.narrative:
Number of wells equipped with operational water meters and in compliance with the quota system (i.e., the volume withdrawn by year is not above the annual quota)
Status as of 30-June-2025: The selection of the private service provider has not yet been completed but is very likely to be finalized during the next semester. A second consultation meeting with companies was held, allowing potential stakeholders to gain a better understanding of the project's objectives and scope. The feedback received helped refine the qualification criteria. Following this second consultation, the technical and financial criteria were revised, and the deadline for submitting applications was extended to June 25, 2025

title.narrative: Farmer with approved request for improved irrigation technologies

comment.narrative:
The indicator measures the area targeted by the project for which a request for FDA subsidy for improved irrigation technology (drip irrigation, microsprinkler, or sprinkler irrigation) has been approved. It is expected that not all farmers will submit a request and switch to improved irrigation systems. The selection criteria for irrigation sectors to be part of the project is to have 70 percent of agricultural land committed to the project.
Status as of Jun. 30, 2025: Exclusively within the ORMVAS area

title.narrative: Number of irrigation areas with quota system in place

comment.narrative:
Number of irrigation areas with quota system in place (water cap informed to the farmer at the beginning of the season and individually monitored long the irrigation period). Tadla is considered in place. ORMVA of Doukkala is the other scheme targeted, considered that it is in a situation of water scarcity and inter-annual variability, as well as the area of Chtouka (using groundwater). Efforts will be made to expand this system also in Haouz and Souss-Massa but the existence of traditional water rights is an additional difficulty for this new system.
Status as of June. 30, 2025: the prolonged shutdown of irrigation services in the area does not allow to record any progress for this indicator. Still the area of Tadla is considered to use the quota system as the low water allocation is allocated in priority for modernized areas and for some priority crops (sugar, cereal seeds and fruit trees).

title.narrative: Client days of training provided per year

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the number of farmers who attended a training session multiplied by the duration of the session expressed in days. Training should relate to the use and management of improved irrigation technologies, production, marketing and/or value addition in agro-processing. This is a non-cumulative indicator; the targets are annual targets.
Status as of 30-June-2025: The start of the training and advisory activities is scheduled to begin shortly.
